top_repositories.momentum: Surged past 1,100 stars within days of launch, driven by intense interest across the frontend engineering ecosystem.
top_repositories.novelty: Re-engineers fundamental CSS utility string merging from the ground up to achieve radical performance gains without altering developer habits.

top_repositories.name: 2akouwu/reverify
top_repositories.reason: Introduces a deterministic verification framework and MCP server designed to eliminate AI hallucinations by testing agent proposals against ground truth.
top_repositories.why_interesting_today: As AI agent frameworks proliferate, agent hallucination remains a critical barrier for production safety. Reverify directly tackles this by combining reverse engineering methodologies with MCP tool checks.
top_repositories.why_developers_should_care: Allows developers building autonomous AI workflows to integrate evidence-based fact verification into their agent harnesses before code or decisions execute.
top_repositories.momentum: Gained nearly 1,000 stars in under a week with active daily commits and community testing.
top_repositories.novelty: Combines binary reverse-engineering paradigms with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enforce hard truth boundaries on LLM reasoning.
